verses.original: וְהָיָ֗ה אִם־ שָׁמ֤וֹעַ תִּשְׁמַע֙ בְּקוֹל֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ לִשְׁמֹ֤ר לַעֲשׂוֹת֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ מִצְוֺתָ֔יו אֲשֶׁ֛ר אָנֹכִ֥י מְצַוְּךָ֖ הַיּ֑וֹם יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֙יךָ֙ עֶלְי֔וֹן וּנְתָ֨נְךָ֜ עַ֖ל כָּל־ גּוֹיֵ֥י הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh ’im- šā·mō·w·a‘ tiš·ma‘ bə·qō·wl Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā liš·mōr la·‘ă·śō·wṯ ’eṯ- kāl- miṣ·wō·ṯāw ’ă·šer ’ā·nō·ḵî mə·ṣaw·wə·ḵā hay·yō·wm Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā ‘el·yō·wn ū·nə·ṯā·nə·ḵā ‘al kāl- gō·w·yê hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Now if you faithfully obey . . . the voice of the LORD your God and are careful to follow - all His commandments - I am giving you today . . . the LORD your God . . . will set you high above all the nations of the earth

verses.original: כָּל־ הָאֵ֖לֶּה הַבְּרָכ֥וֹת וּבָ֧אוּ עָלֶ֛יךָ וְהִשִּׂיגֻ֑ךָ כִּ֣י תִשְׁמַ֔ע בְּק֖וֹל יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- hā·’êl·leh hab·bə·rā·ḵō·wṯ ū·ḇā·’ū ‘ā·le·ḵā wə·hiś·śî·ḡu·ḵā kî ṯiš·ma‘ bə·qō·wl Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā
verses.literal: And all these blessings will come upon you and overtake you if you will obey the voice of the LORD your God

verses.original: אַתָּ֖ה בָּר֥וּךְ בָּעִ֑יר וּבָר֥וּךְ אַתָּ֖ה בַּשָּׂדֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’at·tāh bā·rūḵ bā·‘îr ū·ḇā·rūḵ ’at·tāh baś·śā·ḏeh
verses.literal: You will be blessed in the city and blessed . . . in the country

verses.original: פְּרִֽי־ בִטְנְךָ֛ בָּר֧וּךְ וּפְרִ֥י אַדְמָתְךָ֖ וּפְרִ֣י בְהֶמְתֶּ֑ךָ שְׁגַ֥ר אֲלָפֶ֖יךָ וְעַשְׁתְּר֥וֹת צֹאנֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: pə·rî- ḇiṭ·nə·ḵā bā·rūḵ ū·p̄ə·rî ’aḏ·mā·ṯə·ḵā ū·p̄ə·rî ḇə·hem·te·ḵā šə·ḡar ’ă·lā·p̄e·ḵā wə·‘aš·tə·rō·wṯ ṣō·ne·ḵā
verses.literal: The fruit of your womb will be blessed as well as the produce of your land and the offspring of your livestock the calves of your herds and the lambs of your flocks

verses.original: טַנְאֲךָ֖ וּמִשְׁאַרְתֶּֽךָ׃ בָּר֥וּךְ
verses.transliteration: ṭan·’ă·ḵā ū·miš·’ar·te·ḵā bā·rūḵ
verses.literal: Your basket and kneading bowl will be blessed

verses.original: אַתָּ֖ה בָּר֥וּךְ בְּבֹאֶ֑ךָ וּבָר֥וּךְ אַתָּ֖ה בְּצֵאתֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ’at·tāh bā·rūḵ bə·ḇō·’e·ḵā ū·ḇā·rūḵ ’at·tāh bə·ṣê·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: You will be blessed when you come in and blessed when you go out

verses.original: יְהוָ֤ה אֶת־ יִתֵּ֨ן אֹיְבֶ֙יךָ֙ הַקָּמִ֣ים עָלֶ֔יךָ נִגָּפִ֖ים לְפָנֶ֑יךָ יֵצְא֣וּ אֵלֶ֔יךָ אֶחָד֙ בְּדֶ֤רֶךְ יָנ֥וּסוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ׃ וּבְשִׁבְעָ֥ה דְרָכִ֖ים
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ’eṯ- yit·tên ’ō·yə·ḇe·ḵā haq·qā·mîm ‘ā·le·ḵā nig·gā·p̄îm lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā yê·ṣə·’ū ’ê·le·ḵā ’e·ḥāḏ bə·ḏe·reḵ yā·nū·sū lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā ū·ḇə·šiḇ·‘āh ḏə·rā·ḵîm
verses.literal: The LORD - will cause the enemies who rise up against you to be defeated before you They will march out against you in one direction but flee from you in seven -

verses.original: יְהוָ֤ה אִתְּךָ֙ אֶת־ יְצַ֨ו הַבְּרָכָ֔ה בַּאֲסָמֶ֕יךָ וּבְכֹ֖ל מִשְׁלַ֣ח יָדֶ֑ךָ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ וּבֵ֣רַכְךָ֔ בָּאָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־ נֹתֵ֥ן לָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ’it·tə·ḵā ’eṯ- yə·ṣaw hab·bə·rā·ḵāh ba·’ă·sā·me·ḵā ū·ḇə·ḵōl miš·laḥ yā·ḏe·ḵā Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā ū·ḇê·raḵ·ḵā bā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer- nō·ṯên lāḵ
verses.literal: The LORD - - will decree a blessing on your barns and on everything to which you put your hand the LORD your God will bless you in the land - He is giving you

verses.original: יְהוָ֥ה לוֹ֙ יְקִֽימְךָ֨ קָד֔וֹשׁ לְעַ֣ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר נִֽשְׁבַּֽע־ לָ֑ךְ כִּ֣י תִשְׁמֹ֗ר אֶת־ מִצְוֺת֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ וְהָלַכְתָּ֖ בִּדְרָכָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh lōw yə·qî·mə·ḵā qā·ḏō·wōš lə·‘am ka·’ă·šer niš·ba‘- lāḵ kî ṯiš·mōr ’eṯ- miṣ·wōṯ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā wə·hā·laḵ·tā biḏ·rā·ḵāw
verses.literal: The LORD will establish you as His holy people just as He has sworn to you if you keep - the commandments of the LORD your God and walk in His ways

verses.original: כָּל־ עַמֵּ֣י הָאָ֔רֶץ וְרָאוּ֙ כִּ֛י נִקְרָ֣א עָלֶ֑יךָ שֵׁ֥ם יְהוָ֖ה וְיָֽרְא֖וּ מִמֶּֽךָּ׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- ‘am·mê hā·’ā·reṣ wə·rā·’ū kî niq·rā ‘ā·le·ḵā šêm Yah·weh wə·yā·rə·’ū mim·me·kā
verses.literal: Then all the peoples of the earth will see that you are called by the name of the LORD and they will stand in awe of you

verses.original: יְהוָה֙ וְהוֹתִֽרְךָ֤ לְטוֹבָ֔ה בִּפְרִ֧י בִטְנְךָ֛ וּבִפְרִ֥י בְהַמְתְּךָ֖ וּבִפְרִ֣י אַדְמָתֶ֑ךָ עַ֚ל הָאֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְהוָ֛ה נִשְׁבַּ֧ע לַאֲבֹתֶ֖יךָ לָ֥תֶת לָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh wə·hō·w·ṯir·ḵā lə·ṭō·w·ḇāh bip̄·rî ḇiṭ·nə·ḵā ū·ḇip̄·rî ḇə·ham·tə·ḵā ū·ḇip̄·rî ’aḏ·mā·ṯe·ḵā ‘al hā·’ă·ḏā·māh ’ă·šer Yah·weh niš·ba‘ la·’ă·ḇō·ṯe·ḵā lā·ṯeṯ lāḵ
verses.literal: The LORD will make you prosper abundantly in the fruit of your womb the offspring of your livestock and the produce of your land in the land that the LORD swore to your fathers to give you

verses.original: יְהוָ֣ה׀ לְ֠ךָ אֶת־ יִפְתַּ֣ח הַשָּׁמַ֗יִם הַטּ֜וֹב אֶת־ אוֹצָר֨וֹ לָתֵ֤ת מְטַֽר־ אַרְצְךָ֙ בְּעִתּ֔וֹ וּלְבָרֵ֕ךְ אֵ֖ת כָּל־ מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה יָדֶ֑ךָ וְהִלְוִ֙יתָ֙ רַבִּ֔ים גּוֹיִ֣ם וְאַתָּ֖ה תִלְוֶֽה׃ לֹ֥א
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh lə·ḵā ’eṯ- yip̄·taḥ haš·šā·ma·yim haṭ·ṭō·wḇ ’eṯ- ’ō·w·ṣā·rōw lā·ṯêṯ mə·ṭar- ’ar·ṣə·ḵā bə·‘it·tōw ū·lə·ḇā·rêḵ ’êṯ kāl- ma·‘ă·śêh yā·ḏe·ḵā wə·hil·wî·ṯā rab·bîm gō·w·yim wə·’at·tāh ṯil·weh lō
verses.literal: The LORD - will open the heavens His abundant - storehouse to send rain on your land in season and to bless - all the work of your hands You will lend to many nations but borrow from none

verses.original: יְהוָ֤ה וּנְתָֽנְךָ֨ לְרֹאשׁ֙ וְלֹ֣א לְזָנָ֔ב וְהָיִ֙יתָ֙ רַ֣ק לְמַ֔עְלָה וְלֹ֥א תִהְיֶ֖ה לְמָ֑טָּה כִּֽי־ תִשְׁמַ֞ע אֶל־ לִשְׁמֹ֥ר וְלַעֲשֽׂוֹת׃ מִצְוֺ֣ת׀ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֗יךָ אֲשֶׁ֨ר אָנֹכִ֧י מְצַוְּךָ֛ הַיּ֖וֹם
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ū·nə·ṯā·nə·ḵā lə·rōš wə·lō lə·zā·nāḇ wə·hā·yî·ṯā raq lə·ma‘·lāh wə·lō ṯih·yeh lə·māṭ·ṭāh kî- ṯiš·ma‘ ’el- liš·mōr wə·la·‘ă·śō·wṯ miṣ·wōṯ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā ’ă·šer ’ā·nō·ḵî mə·ṣaw·wə·ḵā hay·yō·wm
verses.literal: The LORD will make you the head and not the tail . . . you will only move upward and never . . . downward if you hear and carefully follow the commandments of the LORD your God which I am giving you today

verses.original: וְלֹ֣א תָס֗וּר יָמִ֣ין וּשְׂמֹ֑אול מִכָּל־ הַדְּבָרִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר אָנֹכִ֜י מְצַוֶּ֥ה אֶתְכֶ֛ם הַיּ֖וֹם לָלֶ֗כֶת אַחֲרֵ֛י אֲחֵרִ֖ים אֱלֹהִ֥ים לְעָבְדָֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·lō ṯā·sūr yā·mîn ū·śə·mō·wl mik·kāl had·də·ḇā·rîm ’ă·šer ’ā·nō·ḵî mə·ṣaw·weh ’eṯ·ḵem hay·yō·wm lā·le·ḵeṯ ’a·ḥă·rê ’ă·ḥê·rîm ’ĕ·lō·hîm lə·‘ā·ḇə·ḏām
verses.literal: Do not turn aside to the right or to the left from any of the words - I command you today and do not go after other gods to serve them

verses.original: וְהָיָ֗ה אִם־ לֹ֤א תִשְׁמַע֙ בְּקוֹל֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ לִשְׁמֹ֤ר לַעֲשׂוֹת֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ מִצְוֺתָ֣יו וְחֻקֹּתָ֔יו אֲשֶׁ֛ר אָנֹכִ֥י מְצַוְּךָ֖ הַיּ֑וֹם כָּל־ הָאֵ֖לֶּה הַקְּלָל֥וֹת וּבָ֧אוּ עָלֶ֛יךָ וְהִשִּׂיגֽוּךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh ’im- lō ṯiš·ma‘ bə·qō·wl Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā liš·mōr la·‘ă·śō·wṯ ’eṯ- kāl- miṣ·wō·ṯāw wə·ḥuq·qō·ṯāw ’ă·šer ’ā·nō·ḵî mə·ṣaw·wə·ḵā hay·yō·wm kāl- hā·’êl·leh haq·qə·lā·lō·wṯ ū·ḇā·’ū ‘ā·le·ḵā wə·hiś·śî·ḡū·ḵā
verses.literal: - If, however you do not obey . . . the LORD your God by carefully following - all His commandments and statutes - I am giving you today . . . all these curses will come upon you and overtake you

verses.original: אַתָּ֖ה אָר֥וּר בָּעִ֑יר וְאָר֥וּר אַתָּ֖ה בַּשָּׂדֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’at·tāh ’ā·rūr bā·‘îr wə·’ā·rūr ’at·tāh baś·śā·ḏeh
verses.literal: You will be cursed in the city and cursed . . . in the country

verses.original: טַנְאֲךָ֖ וּמִשְׁאַרְתֶּֽךָ׃ אָר֥וּר
verses.transliteration: ṭan·’ă·ḵā ū·miš·’ar·te·ḵā ’ā·rūr
verses.literal: Your basket and kneading bowl will be cursed

verses.original: פְּרִֽי־ בִטְנְךָ֖ אָר֥וּר וּפְרִ֣י אַדְמָתֶ֑ךָ שְׁגַ֥ר אֲלָפֶ֖יךָ וְעַשְׁתְּר֥וֹת צֹאנֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: pə·rî- ḇiṭ·nə·ḵā ’ā·rūr ū·p̄ə·rî ’aḏ·mā·ṯe·ḵā šə·ḡar ’ă·lā·p̄e·ḵā wə·‘aš·tə·rō·wṯ ṣō·ne·ḵā
verses.literal: The fruit of your womb will be cursed as well as the produce of your land the calves of your herds and the lambs of your flocks

verses.original: אַתָּ֖ה אָר֥וּר בְּבֹאֶ֑ךָ וְאָר֥וּר אַתָּ֖ה בְּצֵאתֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ’at·tāh ’ā·rūr bə·ḇō·’e·ḵā wə·’ā·rūr ’at·tāh bə·ṣê·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: You will be cursed when you come in and cursed when you go out

verses.original: יְהוָ֣ה׀ יְשַׁלַּ֣ח הַמְּאֵרָ֤ה אֶת־ בְּ֠ךָ אֶת־ הַמְּהוּמָה֙ וְאֶת־ הַמִּגְעֶ֔רֶת בְּכָל־ מִשְׁלַ֥ח יָדְךָ֖ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תַּעֲשֶׂ֑ה עַ֣ד הִשָּֽׁמֶדְךָ֤ וְעַד־ מַהֵ֔ר אֲבָדְךָ֙ מִפְּנֵ֛י רֹ֥עַ מַֽעֲלָלֶ֖יךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר עֲזַבְתָּֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh yə·šal·laḥ ham·mə·’ê·rāh ’eṯ- bə·ḵā ’eṯ- ham·mə·hū·māh wə·’eṯ- ham·miḡ·‘e·reṯ bə·ḵāl miš·laḥ yā·ḏə·ḵā ’ă·šer ta·‘ă·śeh ‘aḏ hiš·šā·meḏ·ḵā wə·‘aḏ- ma·hêr ’ă·ḇā·ḏə·ḵā mip·pə·nê rō·a‘ ma·‘ă·lā·le·ḵā ’ă·šer ‘ă·zaḇ·tā·nî
verses.literal: The LORD will send curses - upon you - confusion and reproof in all to which you put your hand - - until you are destroyed . . . and quickly perish because of the wickedness you have committed - in forsaking Him

verses.original: יְהוָ֛ה הַדָּ֑בֶר יַדְבֵּ֧ק בְּךָ֖ אֶת־ עַ֚ד כַּלֹּת֣וֹ אֹֽתְךָ֔ מֵעַל֙ הָֽאֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־ אַתָּ֥ה בָא־ שָׁ֖מָּה לְרִשְׁתָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh had·dā·ḇer yaḏ·bêq bə·ḵā ’eṯ- ‘aḏ kal·lō·ṯōw ’ō·ṯə·ḵā mê·‘al hā·’ă·ḏā·māh ’ă·šer- ’at·tāh ḇā- šām·māh lə·riš·tāh
verses.literal: The LORD will make the plague cling to you until He has exterminated you from the land that you are entering . . . to possess

verses.original: יְ֠הוָה יַכְּכָ֣ה בַּשַּׁחֶ֨פֶת וּבַקַּדַּ֜חַת וּבַדַּלֶּ֗קֶת וּבַֽחַרְחֻר֙ וּבַחֶ֔רֶב וּבַשִּׁדָּפ֖וֹן וּבַיֵּרָק֑וֹן וּרְדָפ֖וּךָ עַ֥ד אָבְדֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh yak·kə·ḵāh baš·ša·ḥe·p̄eṯ ū·ḇaq·qad·da·ḥaṯ ū·ḇad·dal·le·qeṯ ū·ḇa·ḥar·ḥur ū·ḇa·ḥe·reḇ ū·ḇaš·šid·dā·p̄ō·wn ū·ḇay·yê·rā·qō·wn ū·rə·ḏā·p̄ū·ḵā ‘aḏ ’ā·ḇə·ḏe·ḵā
verses.literal: The LORD will strike you with wasting disease with fever and inflammation with scorching heat and drought and with blight and mildew these will pursue you until you perish

verses.original: שָׁמֶ֛יךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר עַל־ רֹאשְׁךָ֖ וְהָי֥וּ נְחֹ֑שֶׁת וְהָאָ֥רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־ תַּחְתֶּ֖יךָ בַּרְזֶֽל׃
verses.transliteration: šā·me·ḵā ’ă·šer ‘al- rō·šə·ḵā wə·hā·yū nə·ḥō·šeṯ wə·hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer- taḥ·te·ḵā bar·zel
verses.literal: The sky - over your head will be bronze and the earth - beneath you iron

verses.original: יְהוָ֛ה אֶת־ יִתֵּ֧ן מְטַ֥ר אַרְצְךָ֖ אָבָ֣ק וְעָפָ֑ר יֵרֵ֣ד עָלֶ֔יךָ מִן־ הַשָּׁמַ֙יִם֙ עַ֖ד הִשָּׁמְדָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ’eṯ- yit·tên mə·ṭar ’ar·ṣə·ḵā ’ā·ḇāq wə·‘ā·p̄ār yê·rêḏ ‘ā·le·ḵā min- haš·šā·ma·yim ‘aḏ hiš·šā·mə·ḏāḵ
verses.literal: The LORD - will turn the rain of your land into dust and powder it will descend on you from the sky until you are destroyed

verses.original: יְהוָ֥ה׀ יִתֶּנְךָ֨ נִגָּף֮ לִפְנֵ֣י אֹיְבֶיךָ֒ תֵּצֵ֣א אֵלָ֔יו אֶחָד֙ בְּדֶ֤רֶךְ תָּנ֣וּס לְפָנָ֑יו וּבְשִׁבְעָ֥ה דְרָכִ֖ים וְהָיִ֣יתָ לְזַעֲוָ֔ה לְכֹ֖ל מַמְלְכ֥וֹת הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh yit·ten·ḵā nig·gāp̄ lip̄·nê ’ō·yə·ḇe·ḵā tê·ṣê ’ê·lāw ’e·ḥāḏ bə·ḏe·reḵ tā·nūs lə·p̄ā·nāw ū·ḇə·šiḇ·‘āh ḏə·rā·ḵîm wə·hā·yî·ṯā lə·za·‘ă·wāh lə·ḵōl mam·lə·ḵō·wṯ hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: The LORD will cause you to be defeated before your enemies You will march out against them in one direction but flee from them in seven - You will be an object of horror to all the kingdoms of the earth

verses.original: נִבְלָֽתְךָ֙ וְהָיְתָ֤ה לְמַאֲכָ֔ל לְכָל־ ע֥וֹף הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם וּלְבֶהֱמַ֣ת הָאָ֑רֶץ וְאֵ֖ין מַחֲרִֽיד׃
verses.transliteration: niḇ·lā·ṯə·ḵā wə·hā·yə·ṯāh lə·ma·’ă·ḵāl lə·ḵāl ‘ō·wp̄ haš·šā·ma·yim ū·lə·ḇe·hĕ·maṯ hā·’ā·reṣ wə·’ên ma·ḥă·rîḏ
verses.literal: Your corpses will be food for all the birds of the air and beasts of the earth with no one to scare them away

verses.original: יְהוָ֜ה יַכְּכָ֨ה בִּשְׁחִ֤ין מִצְרַ֙יִם֙ וּבָעֳפָלִים וּבַגָּרָ֖ב וּבֶחָ֑רֶס אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־ תוּכַ֖ל לְהֵרָפֵֽא׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh yak·kə·ḵāh biš·ḥîn miṣ·ra·yim ū·ḇå̄·ʿo·p̄å̄·līm ū·ḇag·gā·rāḇ ū·ḇe·ḥā·res ’ă·šer lō- ṯū·ḵal lə·hê·rā·p̄ê
verses.literal: The LORD will afflict you with the boils of Egypt with tumors and scabs and itch from which you cannot . . . be cured

verses.original: יְהוָ֔ה יַכְּכָ֣ה בְּשִׁגָּע֖וֹן וּבְעִוָּר֑וֹן וּבְתִמְה֖וֹן לֵבָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh yak·kə·ḵāh bə·šig·gā·‘ō·wn ū·ḇə·‘iw·wā·rō·wn ū·ḇə·ṯim·hō·wn lê·ḇāḇ
verses.literal: The LORD will afflict you with madness blindness and confusion of mind

verses.original: בַּֽצָּהֳרַ֗יִם וְהָיִ֜יתָ מְמַשֵּׁ֣שׁ כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר הָעִוֵּר֙ יְמַשֵּׁ֤שׁ בָּאֲפֵלָ֔ה וְלֹ֥א תַצְלִ֖יחַ אֶת־ דְּרָכֶ֑יךָ כָּל־ וְהָיִ֜יתָ אַ֣ךְ עָשׁ֧וּק וְגָז֛וּל הַיָּמִ֖ים וְאֵ֥ין מוֹשִֽׁיעַ׃
verses.transliteration: baṣ·ṣā·ho·ra·yim wə·hā·yî·ṯā mə·maš·šêš ka·’ă·šer hā·‘iw·wêr yə·maš·šêš bā·’ă·p̄ê·lāh wə·lō ṯaṣ·lî·aḥ ’eṯ- də·rā·ḵe·ḵā kāl- wə·hā·yî·ṯā ’aḵ ‘ā·šūq wə·ḡā·zūl hay·yā·mîm wə·’ên mō·wō·šî·a‘
verses.literal: and at noon you will grope about like a blind man - in the darkness You will not prosper - in your ways Day after day you will be - oppressed and plundered . . . with no one to save you

verses.original: תְאָרֵ֗שׂ אִשָּׁ֣ה אַחֵר֙ וְאִ֤ישׁ יִשְׁגָּלֶנָּה תִּבְנֶ֖ה בַּ֥יִת וְלֹא־ תֵשֵׁ֣ב בּ֑וֹ תִּטַּ֖ע כֶּ֥רֶם וְלֹ֥א תְחַלְּלֶּֽנּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ṯə·’ā·rêś ’iš·šāh ’a·ḥêr wə·’îš yiš·gå̄·lɛn·nå̄h tiḇ·neh ba·yiṯ wə·lō- ṯê·šêḇ bōw tiṭ·ṭa‘ ke·rem wə·lō ṯə·ḥal·ləl·lɛn·nū
verses.literal: You will be pledged in marriage to a woman but another man will violate her You will build a house but will not live in it You will plant a vineyard but will not enjoy its fruit

verses.original: שׁוֹרְךָ֞ טָב֣וּחַ לְעֵינֶ֗יךָ וְלֹ֣א תֹאכַל֮ מִמֶּנּוּ֒ חֲמֹֽרְךָ֙ גָּז֣וּל מִלְּפָנֶ֔יךָ וְלֹ֥א יָשׁ֖וּב לָ֑ךְ צֹֽאנְךָ֙ נְתֻנ֣וֹת לְאֹיְבֶ֔יךָ וְאֵ֥ין מוֹשִֽׁיעַ׃ לְךָ֖
verses.transliteration: šō·wr·ḵā ṭā·ḇū·aḥ lə·‘ê·ne·ḵā wə·lō ṯō·ḵal mim·men·nū ḥă·mō·rə·ḵā gā·zūl mil·lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā wə·lō yā·šūḇ lāḵ ṣō·nə·ḵā nə·ṯu·nō·wṯ lə·’ō·yə·ḇe·ḵā wə·’ên mō·wō·šî·a‘ lə·ḵā
verses.literal: Your ox will be slaughtered before your eyes but you will not eat any of it Your donkey will be taken away - and not returned to you Your flock will be given to your enemies and no one will save you

verses.original: בָּנֶ֨יךָ וּבְנֹתֶ֜יךָ נְתֻנִ֨ים אַחֵר֙ לְעַ֤ם וְעֵינֶ֣יךָ וְכָל֥וֹת רֹא֔וֹת אֲלֵיהֶ֖ם כָּל־ הַיּ֑וֹם וְאֵ֥ין לְאֵ֖ל יָדֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: bā·ne·ḵā ū·ḇə·nō·ṯe·ḵā nə·ṯu·nîm ’a·ḥêr lə·‘am wə·‘ê·ne·ḵā wə·ḵā·lō·wṯ rō·’ō·wṯ ’ă·lê·hem kāl- hay·yō·wm wə·’ên lə·’êl yā·ḏe·ḵā
verses.literal: Your sons and daughters will be given to another nation while your eyes grow weary looking for them vvv day after day with no power in your hand

verses.original: עַ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא־ יָדָ֑עְתָּ יֹאכַ֥ל פְּרִ֤י אַדְמָֽתְךָ֙ וְכָל־ יְגִ֣יעֲךָ֔ כָּל־ הַיָּמִֽים׃ וְהָיִ֗יתָ רַ֛ק עָשׁ֥וּק וְרָצ֖וּץ
verses.transliteration: ‘am ’ă·šer lō- yā·ḏā·‘ə·tā yō·ḵal pə·rî ’aḏ·mā·ṯə·ḵā wə·ḵāl yə·ḡî·‘ă·ḵā kāl- hay·yā·mîm wə·hā·yî·ṯā raq ‘ā·šūq wə·rā·ṣūṣ
verses.literal: A people - you do not know will eat the produce of your land and of all your toil All your days you will be - oppressed and crushed

verses.original: וְהָיִ֖יתָ מְשֻׁגָּ֑ע מִמַּרְאֵ֥ה עֵינֶ֖יךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּרְאֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yî·ṯā mə·šug·gā‘ mim·mar·’êh ‘ê·ne·ḵā ’ă·šer tir·’eh
verses.literal: You will be driven mad by the sights . . . - you see

verses.original: יְהוָ֜ה יַכְּכָ֨ה רָ֗ע אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־ תוּכַ֖ל לְהֵרָפֵ֑א בִּשְׁחִ֣ין עַל־ הַבִּרְכַּ֙יִם֙ וְעַל־ הַשֹּׁקַ֔יִם מִכַּ֥ף רַגְלְךָ֖ וְעַ֥ד קָדְקֳדֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh yak·kə·ḵāh rā‘ ’ă·šer lō- ṯū·ḵal lə·hê·rā·p̄ê biš·ḥîn ‘al- hab·bir·ka·yim wə·‘al- haš·šō·qa·yim mik·kap̄ raḡ·lə·ḵā wə·‘aḏ qā·ḏə·qo·ḏe·ḵā
verses.literal: The LORD will afflict you with painful - vvv incurable . . . boils on your knees . . . and thighs from the soles of your feet to the top of your head

verses.original: יְהוָ֜ה יוֹלֵ֨ךְ אֹֽתְךָ֗ וְאֶֽת־ מַלְכְּךָ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תָּקִ֣ים עָלֶ֔יךָ אֶל־ גּ֕וֹי אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתָּ֣ה לֹא־ וַאֲבֹתֶ֑יךָ יָדַ֖עְתָּ שָּׁ֛ם וְעָבַ֥דְתָּ אֲחֵרִ֖ים אֱלֹהִ֥ים עֵ֥ץ וָאָֽבֶן׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh yō·w·lêḵ ’ō·ṯə·ḵā wə·’eṯ- mal·kə·ḵā ’ă·šer tā·qîm ‘ā·le·ḵā ’el- gō·w ’ă·šer ’at·tāh lō- wa·’ă·ḇō·ṯe·ḵā yā·ḏa‘·tā šām wə·‘ā·ḇaḏ·tā ’ă·ḥê·rîm ’ĕ·lō·hîm ‘êṣ wā·’ā·ḇen
verses.literal: The LORD will bring you and the king you appoint . . . to a nation - neither you nor your fathers have known and there you will worship other gods [gods] of wood and stone

verses.original: וְהָיִ֣יתָ לְשַׁמָּ֔ה לְמָשָׁ֖ל וְלִשְׁנִינָ֑ה בְּכֹל֙ הָֽעַמִּ֔ים אֲשֶׁר־ יְהוָ֖ה שָֽׁמָּה׃ יְנַהֶגְךָ֥
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yî·ṯā lə·šam·māh lə·mā·šāl wə·liš·nî·nāh bə·ḵōl hā·‘am·mîm ’ă·šer- Yah·weh šām·māh yə·na·heḡ·ḵā
verses.literal: You will become an object of horror scorn and ridicule among all the nations to which the LORD . . . will drive you

verses.original: תּוֹצִ֣יא רַ֖ב זֶ֥רַע הַשָּׂדֶ֑ה תֶּאֱסֹ֔ף וּמְעַ֣ט כִּ֥י הָאַרְבֶּֽה׃ יַחְסְלֶ֖נּוּ
verses.transliteration: tō·w·ṣî raḇ ze·ra‘ haś·śā·ḏeh te·’ĕ·sōp̄ ū·mə·‘aṭ kî hā·’ar·beh yaḥ·sə·len·nū
verses.literal: You will sow much seed in the field but harvest little because the locusts will consume it

verses.original: תִּטַּ֖ע וְעָבָ֑דְתָּ כְּרָמִ֥ים לֹֽא־ תִשְׁתֶּה֙ וְיַ֤יִן וְלֹ֣א תֶאֱגֹ֔ר כִּ֥י הַתֹּלָֽעַת׃ תֹאכְלֶ֖נּוּ
verses.transliteration: tiṭ·ṭa‘ wə·‘ā·ḇā·ḏə·tā kə·rā·mîm lō- ṯiš·teh wə·ya·yin wə·lō ṯe·’ĕ·ḡōr kî hat·tō·lā·‘aṯ ṯō·ḵə·len·nū
verses.literal: You will plant and cultivate vineyards but will neither drink the wine nor gather [the grapes] because worms will eat them

verses.original: יִהְי֥וּ לְךָ֖ זֵיתִ֛ים בְּכָל־ גְּבוּלֶ֑ךָ לֹ֣א תָס֔וּךְ וְשֶׁ֙מֶן֙ כִּ֥י זֵיתֶֽךָ׃ יִשַּׁ֖ל
verses.transliteration: yih·yū lə·ḵā zê·ṯîm bə·ḵāl gə·ḇū·le·ḵā lō ṯā·sūḵ wə·še·men kî zê·ṯe·ḵā yiš·šal
verses.literal: You will have olive trees throughout your territory but will never anoint yourself with oil because the olives will drop off

verses.original: תּוֹלִ֑יד בָּנִ֥ים וּבָנ֖וֹת וְלֹא־ יִהְי֣וּ לָ֔ךְ כִּ֥י יֵלְכ֖וּ בַּשֶּֽׁבִי׃
verses.transliteration: tō·w·lîḏ bā·nîm ū·ḇā·nō·wṯ wə·lō- yih·yū lāḵ kî yê·lə·ḵū baš·še·ḇî
verses.literal: You will father sons and daughters but they will not remain yours because they will go into captivity

verses.original: הַצְּלָצַֽל׃ יְיָרֵ֖שׁ כָּל־ עֵצְךָ֖ וּפְרִ֣י אַדְמָתֶ֑ךָ
verses.transliteration: haṣ·ṣə·lā·ṣal yə·yā·rêš kāl- ‘ê·ṣə·ḵā ū·p̄ə·rî ’aḏ·mā·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: Swarms of locusts will consume all your trees and the produce of your land

verses.original: הַגֵּר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּקִרְבְּךָ֔ יַעֲלֶ֥ה מַ֣עְלָה מָּ֑עְלָה עָלֶ֖יךָ וְאַתָּ֥ה תֵרֵ֖ד מַ֥טָּה מָּֽטָּה׃
verses.transliteration: hag·gêr ’ă·šer bə·qir·bə·ḵā ya·‘ă·leh ma‘·lāh mā·‘ə·lāh ‘ā·le·ḵā wə·’at·tāh ṯê·rêḏ maṭ·ṭāh māṭ·ṭāh
verses.literal: The foreigner living - among you will rise higher and higher above you while you sink down lower and lower

verses.original: ה֣וּא יַלְוְךָ֔ וְאַתָּ֖ה לֹ֣א תַלְוֶ֑נּוּ ה֚וּא יִהְיֶ֣ה לְרֹ֔אשׁ וְאַתָּ֖ה תִּֽהְיֶ֥ה לְזָנָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: hū yal·wə·ḵā wə·’at·tāh lō ṯal·wen·nū hū yih·yeh lə·rōš wə·’at·tāh tih·yeh lə·zā·nāḇ
verses.literal: He will lend to you but you will not lend to him He will be the head and you will be the tail

verses.original: כָּל־ הָאֵ֗לֶּה הַקְּלָל֣וֹת וּבָ֨אוּ עָלֶ֜יךָ וּרְדָפ֙וּךָ֙ וְהִשִּׂיג֔וּךָ עַ֖ד הִשָּֽׁמְדָ֑ךְ כִּי־ לֹ֣א שָׁמַ֗עְתָּ בְּקוֹל֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ לִשְׁמֹ֛ר מִצְוֺתָ֥יו וְחֻקֹּתָ֖יו אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוָּֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- hā·’êl·leh haq·qə·lā·lō·wṯ ū·ḇā·’ū ‘ā·le·ḵā ū·rə·ḏā·p̄ū·ḵā wə·hiś·śî·ḡū·ḵā ‘aḏ hiš·šā·mə·ḏāḵ kî- lō šā·ma‘·tā bə·qō·wl Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā liš·mōr miṣ·wō·ṯāw wə·ḥuq·qō·ṯāw ’ă·šer ṣiw·wāḵ
verses.literal: All these curses will come upon you They will pursue you and overtake you until you are destroyed since you did not obey . . . the LORD your God and keep the commandments and statutes - He gave you

verses.original: וְהָי֣וּ לְא֖וֹת וּלְמוֹפֵ֑ת בְךָ֔ וּֽבְזַרְעֲךָ֖ עַד־ עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yū lə·’ō·wṯ ū·lə·mō·w·p̄êṯ ḇə·ḵā ū·ḇə·zar·‘ă·ḵā ‘aḏ- ‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: These curses will be a sign and a wonder upon you and your descendants forever . . .

verses.original: תַּ֗חַת אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹא־ עָבַ֙דְתָּ֙ אֶת־ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ בְּשִׂמְחָ֖ה וּבְט֣וּב לֵבָ֑ב כֹּֽל׃ מֵרֹ֖ב
verses.transliteration: ta·ḥaṯ ’ă·šer lō- ‘ā·ḇaḏ·tā ’eṯ- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā bə·śim·ḥāh ū·ḇə·ṭūḇ lê·ḇāḇ kōl mê·rōḇ
verses.literal: Because - you did not serve - the LORD your God with joy and gladness of heart in all your abundance

verses.original: וְעָבַדְתָּ֣ אֶת־ אֹיְבֶ֗יךָ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְהוָה֙ יְשַׁלְּחֶ֤נּוּ בָּ֔ךְ בְּרָעָ֧ב וּבְצָמָ֛א וּבְעֵירֹ֖ם וּבְחֹ֣סֶר כֹּ֑ל וְנָתַ֞ן בַּרְזֶל֙ עֹ֤ל עַל־ צַוָּארֶ֔ךָ עַ֥ד הִשְׁמִיד֖וֹ אֹתָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·ḇaḏ·tā ’eṯ- ’ō·yə·ḇe·ḵā ’ă·šer Yah·weh yə·šal·lə·ḥen·nū bāḵ bə·rā·‘āḇ ū·ḇə·ṣā·mā ū·ḇə·‘ê·rōm ū·ḇə·ḥō·ser kōl wə·nā·ṯan bar·zel ‘ōl ‘al- ṣaw·wā·re·ḵā ‘aḏ hiš·mî·ḏōw ’ō·ṯāḵ
verses.literal: you will serve - your enemies - the LORD will send against you in famine thirst nakedness and destitution . . . He will place an iron yoke on your neck until He has destroyed you

verses.original: יְהוָה֩ יִשָּׂ֣א גּ֤וֹי מֵרָחוֹק֙ מִקְצֵ֣ה הָאָ֔רֶץ יִדְאֶ֖ה עָלֶ֨יךָ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר הַנָּ֑שֶׁר גּ֕וֹי אֲשֶׁ֥ר לְשֹׁנֽוֹ׃ לֹא־ תִשְׁמַ֖ע
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh yiś·śā gō·w mê·rā·ḥō·wq miq·ṣêh hā·’ā·reṣ yiḏ·’eh ‘ā·le·ḵā ka·’ă·šer han·nā·šer gō·w ’ă·šer lə·šō·nōw lō- ṯiš·ma‘
verses.literal: The LORD will bring a nation from afar from the ends of the earth to swoop down upon you like an eagle a nation whose language you will not understand

verses.original: עַ֣ז פָּנִ֑ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר גּ֖וֹי לֹא־ יִשָּׂ֤א פָנִים֙ לְזָקֵ֔ן לֹ֥א יָחֹֽן׃ וְנַ֖עַר
verses.transliteration: ‘az pā·nîm ’ă·šer gō·w lō- yiś·śā p̄ā·nîm lə·zā·qên lō yā·ḥōn wə·na·‘ar
verses.literal: a ruthless . . . - nation with no respect . . . for the old and no pity for the young

verses.original: וְ֠אָכַל פְּרִ֨י בְהֶמְתְּךָ֥ וּפְרִֽי־ אַדְמָתְךָ֮ עַ֣ד הִשָּֽׁמְדָךְ֒ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יַשְׁאִ֜יר לְךָ֗ לֹֽא־ דָּגָן֙ תִּיר֣וֹשׁ וְיִצְהָ֔ר שְׁגַ֥ר אֲלָפֶ֖יךָ וְעַשְׁתְּרֹ֣ת צֹאנֶ֑ךָ עַ֥ד הַאֲבִיד֖וֹ אֹתָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·ḵal pə·rî ḇə·hem·tə·ḵā ū·p̄ə·rî- ’aḏ·mā·ṯə·ḵā ‘aḏ hiš·šā·mə·ḏāḵ ’ă·šer yaš·’îr lə·ḵā lō- dā·ḡān tî·rō·wōš wə·yiṣ·hār šə·ḡar ’ă·lā·p̄e·ḵā wə·‘aš·tə·rōṯ ṣō·ne·ḵā ‘aḏ ha·’ă·ḇî·ḏōw ’ō·ṯāḵ
verses.literal: They will eat the offspring of your livestock and the produce of your land until you are destroyed - They will leave you no grain or new wine or oil no calves of your herds or lambs of your flocks until they have caused you to perish -

verses.original: וְהֵצַ֨ר לְךָ֜ בְּכָל־ שְׁעָרֶ֗יךָ בְּכָל־ אַרְצֶ֑ךָ עַ֣ד הַגְּבֹה֣וֹת וְהַבְּצֻר֔וֹת חֹמֹתֶ֙יךָ֙ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתָּ֛ה בֹּטֵ֥חַ בָּהֵ֖ן רֶ֤דֶת וְהֵצַ֤ר לְךָ֙ בְּכָל־ שְׁעָרֶ֔יךָ בְּכָ֨ל־ אַרְצְךָ֔ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ נָתַ֛ן לָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hê·ṣar lə·ḵā bə·ḵāl šə·‘ā·re·ḵā bə·ḵāl ’ar·ṣe·ḵā ‘aḏ hag·gə·ḇō·hō·wṯ wə·hab·bə·ṣu·rō·wṯ ḥō·mō·ṯe·ḵā ’ă·šer ’at·tāh bō·ṭê·aḥ bā·hên re·ḏeṯ wə·hê·ṣar lə·ḵā bə·ḵāl šə·‘ā·re·ḵā bə·ḵāl ’ar·ṣə·ḵā ’ă·šer Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā nā·ṯan lāḵ
verses.literal: They will besiege - all the cities throughout your land until the high and fortified walls in which you trust have fallen They will besiege all your cities throughout the land that the LORD your God has given you

verses.original: וְאָכַלְתָּ֣ פְרִֽי־ בִטְנְךָ֗ בְּשַׂ֤ר בָּנֶ֙יךָ֙ וּבְנֹתֶ֔יךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ נָֽתַן־ לְךָ֖ בְּמָצוֹר֙ וּבְמָצ֔וֹק אֲשֶׁר־ אֹיְבֶֽךָ׃ יָצִ֥יק לְךָ֖
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·ḵal·tā p̄ə·rî- ḇiṭ·nə·ḵā bə·śar bā·ne·ḵā ū·ḇə·nō·ṯe·ḵā ’ă·šer Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā nā·ṯan- lə·ḵā bə·mā·ṣō·wr ū·ḇə·mā·ṣō·wq ’ă·šer- ’ō·yə·ḇe·ḵā yā·ṣîq lə·ḵā
verses.literal: Then you will eat the fruit of your womb the flesh of the sons and daughters whom the LORD your God has given you in the siege and distress that your enemy will inflict on you

verses.original: מְאֹ֑ד הָרַ֣ךְ וְהֶעָנֹ֖ג הָאִישׁ֙ בְּךָ֔ תֵּרַ֨ע עֵינ֤וֹ בְאָחִיו֙ וּבְאֵ֣שֶׁת חֵיק֔וֹ וּבְיֶ֥תֶר בָּנָ֖יו אֲשֶׁ֥ר יוֹתִֽיר׃
verses.transliteration: mə·’ōḏ hā·raḵ wə·he·‘ā·nōḡ hā·’îš bə·ḵā tê·ra‘ ‘ê·nōw ḇə·’ā·ḥîw ū·ḇə·’ê·šeṯ ḥê·qōw ū·ḇə·ye·ṯer bā·nāw ’ă·šer yō·w·ṯîr
verses.literal: The most gentle and refined man among you will begrudge . . . his brother the wife he embraces and the rest of his children - who have survived

verses.original: מִתֵּ֣ת׀ לְאַחַ֣ד מֵהֶ֗ם מִבְּשַׂ֤ר בָּנָיו֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יֹאכֵ֔ל מִבְּלִ֥י ל֖וֹ כֹּ֑ל הִשְׁאִֽיר־ בְּמָצוֹר֙ וּבְמָצ֔וֹק אֲשֶׁ֨ר אֹיִבְךָ֖ יָצִ֥יק לְךָ֛ בְּכָל־ שְׁעָרֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: mit·têṯ lə·’a·ḥaḏ mê·hem mib·bə·śar bā·nāw ’ă·šer yō·ḵêl mib·bə·lî lōw kōl hiš·’îr- bə·mā·ṣō·wr ū·ḇə·mā·ṣō·wq ’ă·šer ’ō·yiḇ·ḵā yā·ṣîq lə·ḵā bə·ḵāl šə·‘ā·re·ḵā
verses.literal: refusing to share with any of them the flesh of his children - he will eat because he has nothing . . . . . . left in the siege and distress that your enemy will inflict on you within all your gates

verses.original: הָרַכָּ֨ה וְהָעֲנֻגָּ֗ה בְךָ֜ וּמֵרֹ֑ךְ מֵהִתְעַנֵּ֖ג אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹא־ נִסְּתָ֤ה הַצֵּ֣ג כַף־ רַגְלָהּ֙ עַל־ הָאָ֔רֶץ תֵּרַ֤ע עֵינָהּ֙ בְּאִ֣ישׁ חֵיקָ֔הּ וּבִבְנָ֖הּ וּבְבִתָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: hā·rak·kāh wə·hā·‘ă·nug·gāh ḇə·ḵā ū·mê·rōḵ mê·hiṯ·‘an·nêḡ ’ă·šer lō- nis·sə·ṯāh haṣ·ṣêḡ ḵap̄- raḡ·lāh ‘al- hā·’ā·reṣ tê·ra‘ ‘ê·nāh bə·’îš ḥê·qāh ū·ḇiḇ·nāh ū·ḇə·ḇit·tāh
verses.literal: The most gentle and refined woman among you so gentle and refined she would not venture to set the sole of her foot on the ground will begrudge . . . the husband she embraces and her son and daughter

verses.original: וּֽבְשִׁלְיָתָ֞הּ הַיּוֹצֵ֣ת׀ מִבֵּ֣ין רַגְלֶ֗יהָ וּבְבָנֶ֙יהָ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תֵּלֵ֔ד כִּֽי־ בַּסָּ֑תֶר תֹאכְלֵ֥ם בְּחֹֽסֶר־ כֹּ֖ל בְּמָצוֹר֙ וּבְמָצ֔וֹק אֲשֶׁ֨ר אֹיִבְךָ֖ יָצִ֥יק לְךָ֛ בִּשְׁעָרֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·šil·yā·ṯāh hay·yō·w·ṣêṯ mib·bên raḡ·le·hā ū·ḇə·ḇā·ne·hā ’ă·šer tê·lêḏ kî- bas·sā·ṯer ṯō·ḵə·lêm bə·ḥō·ser- kōl bə·mā·ṣō·wr ū·ḇə·mā·ṣō·wq ’ă·šer ’ō·yiḇ·ḵā yā·ṣîq lə·ḵā biš·‘ā·re·ḵā
verses.literal: the afterbirth that comes from between her legs and the children - she bears because she will secretly eat them for lack of anything else in the siege and distress that your enemy will inflict on you within your gates

verses.original: אִם־ לֹ֨א תִשְׁמֹ֜ר לַעֲשׂ֗וֹת אֶת־ כָּל־ דִּבְרֵי֙ הַזֹּ֔את הַתּוֹרָ֣ה הַכְּתוּבִ֖ים הַזֶּ֑ה בַּסֵּ֣פֶר לְ֠יִרְאָה אֶת־ הַנִּכְבָּ֤ד וְהַנּוֹרָא֙ הַזֶּ֔ה אֵ֖ת הַשֵּׁ֞ם יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- lō ṯiš·mōr la·‘ă·śō·wṯ ’eṯ- kāl- diḇ·rê haz·zōṯ hat·tō·w·rāh hak·kə·ṯū·ḇîm haz·zeh bas·sê·p̄er lə·yir·’āh ’eṯ- han·niḵ·bāḏ wə·han·nō·w·rā haz·zeh ’êṯ haš·šêm Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā
verses.literal: If you are not careful to observe - all the words of this law which are written in this book that you may fear - this glorious and awesome . . . - name the LORD your God

verses.original: יְהוָה֙ אֶת־ וְאֵ֖ת זַרְעֶ֑ךָ וְהִפְלָ֤א מַכֹּ֣תְךָ֔ מַכּ֤וֹת גְּדֹלוֹת֙ וְנֶ֣אֱמָנ֔וֹת מַכּ֣וֹת רָעִ֖ים וְנֶאֱמָנִֽים׃ וָחֳלָיִ֥ם
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ’eṯ- wə·’êṯ zar·‘e·ḵā wə·hip̄·lā mak·kō·ṯə·ḵā mak·kō·wṯ gə·ḏō·lō·wṯ wə·ne·’ĕ·mā·nō·wṯ mak·kō·wṯ rā·‘îm wə·ne·’ĕ·mā·nîm wā·ḥo·lā·yim
verses.literal: He - - {will bring} upon you and your descendants extraordinary disasters . . . severe and lasting plagues and terrible and chronic sicknesses

verses.original: וְהֵשִׁ֣יב בְּךָ֗ אֵ֚ת כָּל־ מַדְוֵ֣ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָגֹ֖רְתָּ מִצְרַ֔יִם מִפְּנֵיהֶ֑ם וְדָבְק֖וּ בָּֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hê·šîḇ bə·ḵā ’êṯ kāl- maḏ·wêh ’ă·šer yā·ḡō·rə·tā miṣ·ra·yim mip·pə·nê·hem wə·ḏā·ḇə·qū bāḵ
verses.literal: He will afflict you again - with all the diseases - you dreaded in Egypt . . . and they will cling to you

verses.original: יְהוָה֙ גַּ֤ם יַעְלֵ֤ם עָלֶ֔יךָ כָּל־ חֳלִי֙ וְכָל־ מַכָּ֔ה אֲשֶׁר֙ לֹ֣א כָת֔וּב הַזֹּ֑את בְּסֵ֖פֶר הַתּוֹרָ֣ה עַ֖ד הִשָּׁמְדָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh gam ya‘·lêm ‘ā·le·ḵā kāl- ḥo·lî wə·ḵāl mak·kāh ’ă·šer lō ḵā·ṯūḇ haz·zōṯ bə·sê·p̄er hat·tō·w·rāh ‘aḏ hiš·šā·mə·ḏāḵ
verses.literal: The LORD will also bring upon you every sickness . . . and plague - not recorded in this Book of the Law until you are destroyed

verses.original: תַּ֚חַת אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֱיִיתֶ֔ם לָרֹ֑ב כְּכוֹכְבֵ֥י הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם וְנִשְׁאַרְתֶּם֙ מְעָ֔ט בִּמְתֵ֣י כִּי־ לֹ֣א שָׁמַ֔עְתָּ בְּק֖וֹל יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ta·ḥaṯ ’ă·šer hĕ·yî·ṯem lā·rōḇ kə·ḵō·wḵ·ḇê haš·šā·ma·yim wə·niš·’ar·tem mə·‘āṭ bim·ṯê kî- lō šā·ma‘·tā bə·qō·wl Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā
verses.literal: - - You who were as numerous as the stars in the sky will be left few in number because you would not obey the voice of the LORD your God

verses.original: וְ֠הָיָה כַּאֲשֶׁר־ שָׂ֨שׂ יְהוָ֜ה עֲלֵיכֶ֗ם לְהֵיטִ֣יב אֶתְכֶם֮ וּלְהַרְבּ֣וֹת אֶתְכֶם֒ כֵּ֣ן יָשִׂ֤ישׂ יְהוָה֙ עֲלֵיכֶ֔ם לְהַאֲבִ֥יד אֶתְכֶ֖ם וּלְהַשְׁמִ֣יד אֶתְכֶ֑ם וְנִסַּחְתֶּם֙ מֵעַ֣ל הָֽאֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־ אַתָּ֥ה בָא־ שָׁ֖מָּה לְרִשְׁתָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh ka·’ă·šer- śāś Yah·weh ‘ă·lê·ḵem lə·hê·ṭîḇ ’eṯ·ḵem ū·lə·har·bō·wṯ ’eṯ·ḵem kên yā·śîś Yah·weh ‘ă·lê·ḵem lə·ha·’ă·ḇîḏ ’eṯ·ḵem ū·lə·haš·mîḏ ’eṯ·ḵem wə·nis·saḥ·tem mê·‘al hā·’ă·ḏā·māh ’ă·šer- ’at·tāh ḇā- šām·māh lə·riš·tāh
verses.literal: - Just as it pleased the LORD - to make you prosper - and multiply - so also it will please Him . . . to annihilate you and destroy you And you will be uprooted from the land - you are entering . . . to possess

verses.original: יְהוָה֙ וֶהֱפִֽיצְךָ֤ בְּכָל־ הָ֣עַמִּ֔ים מִקְצֵ֥ה הָאָ֖רֶץ וְעַד־ קְצֵ֣ה הָאָ֑רֶץ שָּׁ֜ם וְעָבַ֨דְתָּ אֲחֵרִ֗ים אֱלֹהִ֣ים עֵ֥ץ וָאָֽבֶן׃ אֲשֶׁ֧ר אַתָּ֥ה לֹא־ וַאֲבֹתֶ֖יךָ יָדַ֛עְתָּ
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh we·hĕ·p̄î·ṣə·ḵā bə·ḵāl hā·‘am·mîm miq·ṣêh hā·’ā·reṣ wə·‘aḏ- qə·ṣêh hā·’ā·reṣ šām wə·‘ā·ḇaḏ·tā ’ă·ḥê·rîm ’ĕ·lō·hîm ‘êṣ wā·’ā·ḇen ’ă·šer ’at·tāh lō- wa·’ă·ḇō·ṯe·ḵā yā·ḏa‘·tā
verses.literal: Then the LORD will scatter you among all the nations from one end of the earth to the other . . . and there you will worship other gods [gods] of wood and stone which neither you nor your fathers have known

verses.original: הָהֵם֙ וּבַגּוֹיִ֤ם לֹ֣א תַרְגִּ֔יעַ יִהְיֶ֥ה וְלֹא־ מָנ֖וֹחַ לְכַף־ רַגְלֶ֑ךָ שָׁם֙ יְהוָ֨ה לְךָ֥ וְנָתַן֩ רַגָּ֔ז לֵ֣ב וְכִלְי֥וֹן עֵינַ֖יִם וְדַֽאֲב֥וֹן נָֽפֶשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: hā·hêm ū·ḇag·gō·w·yim lō ṯar·gî·a‘ yih·yeh wə·lō- mā·nō·w·aḥ lə·ḵap̄- raḡ·le·ḵā šām Yah·weh lə·ḵā wə·nā·ṯan rag·gāz lêḇ wə·ḵil·yō·wn ‘ê·na·yim wə·ḏa·’ă·ḇō·wn nā·p̄eš
verses.literal: Among those nations you will find no repose not even a resting place for the sole of your foot There the LORD will give you a trembling heart failing eyes and a despairing soul

verses.original: וְהָי֣וּ חַיֶּ֔יךָ תְּלֻאִ֥ים לְךָ֖ מִנֶּ֑גֶד וּפָֽחַדְתָּ֙ לַ֣יְלָה וְיוֹמָ֔ם וְלֹ֥א תַאֲמִ֖ין בְּחַיֶּֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yū ḥay·ye·ḵā tə·lu·’îm lə·ḵā min·ne·ḡeḏ ū·p̄ā·ḥaḏ·tā lay·lāh wə·yō·w·mām wə·lō ṯa·’ă·mîn bə·ḥay·ye·ḵā
verses.literal: - So your life will hang in doubt before you and you will be afraid night and day never certain of survival

verses.original: בַּבֹּ֤קֶר תֹּאמַר֙ מִֽי־ יִתֵּ֣ן עֶ֔רֶב וּבָעֶ֥רֶב תֹּאמַ֖ר מִֽי־ יִתֵּ֣ן בֹּ֑קֶר מִפַּ֤חַד לְבָֽבְךָ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּפְחָ֔ד וּמִמַּרְאֵ֥ה עֵינֶ֖יךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּרְאֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: bab·bō·qer tō·mar mî- yit·tên ‘e·reḇ ū·ḇā·‘e·reḇ tō·mar mî- yit·tên bō·qer mip·pa·ḥaḏ lə·ḇā·ḇə·ḵā ’ă·šer tip̄·ḥāḏ ū·mim·mar·’êh ‘ê·ne·ḵā ’ă·šer tir·’eh
verses.literal: In the morning you will say If only . . . it were evening and in the evening you will say If only . . . it were morning because of the dread in your hearts of the terrifying sights . . . - you will see

verses.original: יְהוָ֥ה׀ וֶֽהֱשִֽׁיבְךָ֨ מִצְרַיִם֮ בָּאֳנִיּוֹת֒ בַּדֶּ֙רֶךְ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָמַ֣רְתִּֽי לְךָ֔ לֹא־ לִרְאֹתָ֑הּ תֹסִ֥יף ע֖וֹד שָׁ֧ם וְהִתְמַכַּרְתֶּ֨ם לְאֹיְבֶ֛יךָ לַעֲבָדִ֥ים וְלִשְׁפָח֖וֹת וְאֵ֥ין קֹנֶֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh we·hĕ·šî·ḇə·ḵā miṣ·ra·yim bā·’o·nî·yō·wṯ bad·de·reḵ ’ă·šer ’ā·mar·tî lə·ḵā lō- lir·’ō·ṯāh ṯō·sîp̄ ‘ō·wḏ šām wə·hiṯ·mak·kar·tem lə·’ō·yə·ḇe·ḵā la·‘ă·ḇā·ḏîm wə·liš·p̄ā·ḥō·wṯ wə·’ên qō·neh
verses.literal: The LORD will return you to Egypt in ships by a route that I said you {should} never see again . . . There you will sell yourselves to your enemies as male and female slaves but no one will buy you
